name: Sharon Hughes
review: **Fit summary:** Strong youth/family program leadership (9+ yrs at YMCA), but limited direct fit vs. the Ops Manager guide's must-haves. **Strengths:** 5+ yrs adolescent services experience, supervised 6-10 staff, grant/community program background. **Gaps:** No clear healthcare/behavioral-health setting, no EHR or formal compliance-documentation experience mentioned, comp ask ($65k) is reasonable. **Recommendation:** Borderline - worth a phone screen to probe compliance/EHR exposure, but not an obvious must-have match.

name: Yoline Lormeus
review: **Fit summary:** Behavioral health credential (Certified Behavioral Health Case Manager) plus MBA is a nice combination, but ops-management seniority is light. **Strengths:** 5+ yrs behavioral health/adolescent services, case management background, strong cover letter. **Gaps:** Only supervised 1-5 employees, current role is teaching (not ops), only 1-2 yrs direct 13-17 adolescent experience. **Recommendation:** Worth a phone screen - credentials are strong, but confirm true ops/supervisory ownership.

name: Laurielen Cardoso da Silva
review: **Fit summary:** Background is speech-language pathology and disability services, not operations management. **Strengths:** Bilingual, compassionate family-engagement experience. **Gaps:** Only 1-2 yrs in target experience areas (guide wants 2+ yrs ops ownership, 1+ yr supervisory), no clear healthcare-operations or compliance-documentation background. **Recommendation:** Weak fit for this specific role - better suited to a clinical/support role than Ops Manager.

name: Melissa Khan
review: **Fit summary:** Strong match - direct Residential Program Manager title with crisis management, incident reporting, and compliance experience. **Strengths:** Supervises 10+ staff, 3-4 yrs behavioral health/adolescent ops, trauma-informed care background, explicit compliance/documentation ownership. **Gaps:** No EHR system named explicitly; desired comp ($70-80k) may run above range. **Recommendation:** Advance to phone screen - one of the stronger matches on must-have criteria.

name: Leyla Eskinova
review: **Fit summary:** Strong operational leadership (Assistant Director, 500+ student program, 10+ supervised), but self-identifies as primarily education/youth-programming rather than clinical mental health. **Strengths:** 5+ yrs ops experience, Master's in School Counseling, strong systems/organizational skills. **Gaps:** Marked her adolescent 13-17 experience as 'a different age group,' no behavioral-health-specific or EHR/compliance background. **Recommendation:** Worth a phone screen given leadership strength, but flag the industry-fit gap directly.

name: Tracy Howze
review: **Fit summary:** Limited seniority for this role - only 16 months as Site Supervisor, most experience is entry-level behavior technician work. **Strengths:** 3-4 yrs adolescent-adjacent experience, genuine passion in cover letter. **Gaps:** Comp expectation listed as $19-21 (hourly), which suggests she may be applying under the assumption this is an hourly/entry role rather than a salaried management position. **Recommendation:** Likely not a fit for the seniority this role requires - worth clarifying comp expectations before advancing, if at all.

name: Brianna Vella
review: **Fit summary:** Strong match - current Director of Operations title with intake, compliance, and EHR-adjacent experience across multiple ABA/behavioral-health organizations. **Strengths:** RBT-certified, supervised 6+ staff, explicit quality-assurance/compliance-review background, clinical intake coordination experience. **Gaps:** No PHP/IOP-specific experience (has general behavioral health). **Recommendation:** Advance to phone screen - well-rounded on both ops and behavioral-health fundamentals.

name: Laura Colucci
review: **Fit summary:** Standout candidate - 9+ yrs progressive behavioral-health leadership with direct PHP & IOP program experience. **Strengths:** Managed a $1M annual budget (dollar figure referenced, per guide's strong-plus), EHR/CARISK/Salesforce systems, 6 grant-funded programs, explicit CQI and audit-compliance track record, supervised 15+ staff. **Gaps:** None significant against this guide. **Recommendation:** Strong advance - this is close to an ideal match on paper.

name: Tamara Riley
review: **Fit summary:** Strong operational and compliance skill set, but no direct behavioral-health work history - background is youth music education, not clinical/treatment settings. **Strengths:** Active DCF Director + Staff Credential (directly relevant to the guide's AHCA/DCF strong-plus), supervised 17 staff, budget/expense management, extensive documentation/reporting systems experience. **Gaps:** No PHP/IOP or behavioral-health-specific experience; describes herself as transitioning into the field. **Recommendation:** Worth a phone screen given the DCF credential and ops strength, but probe the industry-transition risk directly.
